title: Acquirer: Sensis Pty Ltd; Target: LookSmart Ltd

body_sections.Summary: Sensis (advertising subsidiary of Telstra) acquired a range of assets of LookSmart Ltd (the Australian assets of LookSmart International Pty Ltd).  Assets include online search tools and staff.
body_sections.Market definition: Various relevant markets were considered, including online directory services, online advertising and marketing, and online search services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: Based on the information provided and other material, staff considered that there was unlikely to be a substantial lessening of competition, due to: - LookSmart and Sensis essentially operating in different segments of the market for Online Advertising and Marketing; - The acquisition allowing Sensis to become more involved in Online Search Services through the use of a "pay for performance" auctioning tool, which it did not previously have; and - Looksmart is able to continue operations in its own right.
